items.title: Reason Machines Open-Sources Aspen, a Git Server Built for AI Agents
items.summary: Reason Machines has open-sourced Aspen, a self-hosted Git server for AI agents. It follows OpenAI’s Pando design and sustained 567 pushes per second on one 8-core server in the company’s own test. The post Reason Machines Open-Sources Aspen, a Git Server Built for AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: 0sec Labs Open-Sources 0, an AI Security Harness With Web UI, CLI and MCP
items.summary: 0sec Labs has open-sourced 0, an AI security harness for code review, pentesting, reverse engineering and fixes. It runs locally through a browser console, a headless CLI and an MCP server, with your own model provider. The post 0sec Labs Open-Sources 0, an AI Security Harness With Web UI, CLI and MCP appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.summary: Google's Elephant-Goldfish Model plugin makes coding agents draft specs, then runs 5 zero-context review stages before any code. The post Google AI Releases Elephant-Goldfish Model Plugin for Spec-First Coding appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9%
items.summary: Nous Research released Arete-27B, an Apache 2.0 fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B. On Nous’s 803-prompt eval, propaganda answers fell from 22% to 0.9% while Hermes Bench stayed flat at 65.60%. items.summary: Explore a comprehensive coding guide for NVIDIA's Dory 1.0 4B looped language model. Learn how to build the pinned llama.cpp branch, analyze loop-by-loop compute costs, test memory caching, and run paired evaluations. items.title: Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
items.summary: Buoyant has released Kinference, an Apache 2.0 inference control plane for vLLM on Kubernetes. It adds declarative routing policies, KV-cache-aware load balancing and per-tenant metrics, and cut median TTFT 95% in Buoyant’s own benchmark. The post Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Zyphra ZYFA: FP8 FlashAttention for AMD MI355X, Up to 1.76x Faster
items.summary: Zyphra released ZYFA, open-source FP8 and BF16 prefill attention kernels for AMD Instinct MI355X. On real model activations, its FP8 kernels run 1.16-1.76x faster than AMD’s AITER, with 62-78% lower error at head dimension 128. The post Zyphra ZYFA: FP8 FlashAttention for AMD MI355X, Up to 1.76x Faster appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Thinking Machines Releases Inkling 2 Small, a 594B MoE With 17B Active
items.summary: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Small, a 594B-parameter MoE with 17B active parameters. It scores 31 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and runs on Tinker, with Apache 2.0 weights planned. The post Thinking Machines Releases Inkling 2 Small, a 594B MoE With 17B Active appeared first on MarkTechPost.
